purpose: Root-cause experiments that preceded the Agent changes. Each was run by hand on the same Windows 11 host as the functional report. The regression runner repeats the ones marked repeatedByRunner.

host.cpu: 12th Gen Intel Core i7-1255U, 12 logical processors

ownedWindows.tool: tools/Probe-UiaWindows.ps1 (Win32 EnumWindows and GetWindow, managed UI Automation client)

observations.uiaName: content text, not the window title

ownedWindows.hiddenOwnedWindows: Invisible owned windows whose owner is also invisible (IME and text-service windows) reported the desktop as their parent. They are not listed before or after the change.
ownedWindows.ownerSnapshotBeforeFix: A snapshot of the owner already contained the modal as a child Window with its button. Only listWindows and a snapshot rooted at the modal HWND were unavailable.
ownedWindows.repeatedByRunner: The modal and popup checks record the same placement for Win32 (#32770 dialog), WPF, WinForms .NET Framework and WinForms .NET 9 in 2026-11-24-uia-defects-functional.json.

awtInvoke.fixture: tests/fixtures/swing-awt/FrameworkFixture.java, mode awt, java.awt.Button "Increment fixture counter" (native class Button)
awtInvoke.method: A new fixture process for every trial. The effect is the count.txt of the fixture changing from 0 to 1 within 2.5 s. Each activation was tried once with the fixture window as launched and once after SetForegroundWindow. The window was the foreground window in all ten trials.

trials.note: keyboard focus moved to the button

trials.activation: MSAA IAccessible.accDoDefaultAction (role push button, default action Press)

trials.call: pattern not offered, element served as a Pane

awtInvoke.source: OpenJDK jdk17u src/java.desktop/windows/native/libawt/windows/awt_Button.cpp: handleAction is called only from AwtButton::WmMouseUp, after AwtButton::WmMouseDown set leftButtonDown and when the release point is inside the client rectangle. The file has no BN_CLICKED, BM_CLICK or WM_COMMAND handling.
awtInvoke.conclusion: UIA_PROVIDER_LIMITATION. The AWT peer ignores every accessibility activation of the HWND, with or without an Agent.
awtInvoke.repeatedByRunner: The invokeAndDuplicateRequest, modal and replacement checks of the Awt rows repeat BM_CLICK and accDoDefaultAction as controls on every run.

winFormsRuntimeIds.tool: tools/Probe-UiaRuntimeIds.ps1 (IUIAutomation COM client declared in C#, independent of both Agents)

managedClientInterference.consequence: The managed client registers a process-wide proxy callback. The runner starts each probe in a process of its own, and Probe-UiaRuntimeIds.ps1 refuses to run in a process that loaded the managed client.

cppAgentDpi.symptom: With the C++ Agent of main, every bounds value was the Java/JNA value divided by 1.25 while paths, roles, names, states and actions were equal. All six framework tree comparisons failed for that reason alone.
cppAgentDpi.cause: cpp-agent.exe declared no DPI awareness. UI Automation returns rectangles in the DPI context of the caller.
cppAgentDpi.after: All six tree comparisons pass, bounds included.

largeListTiming.what: Snapshot of the Win32 fixture with 10,000 virtual rows, maxElements 2000, request limit 10 s. cppMain is the unmodified C++ Agent of commit 8823168 built on this host.
largeListTiming.conclusion: The capture time of this fixture varies by a factor of two on this laptop for all three Agents, the unmodified one included. The change did not cause the timeouts.

javaMaven.note: The 4 skipped tests are the GUI integration tests below.

javaGui.note: The PowerShell and JNA backends passed. The C# worker test and the three-backend tree comparison need workers/csharp/bin/Release/UiaWorker.exe, which is not built on this host. A first attempt failed both cursor assertions while the mouse of the host was in use, and the repeat passed.
